title: config/daemon-alerts.json
description: The alerts the daemons raise, each by a reading crossing a line. message is a template in Daemon/messages.json; recovered, if given, is sent once the reading is back. sustain_s, if given, is how long the reading must stay over the line first; otherwise the launcher's setting (daemon.sustain_s) applies. The Resource Control Subsystem's own limits, α, β and γ for each module, are settings of their own (rcs.*).

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editors.

_about.description: What this file is. Not read by any program.

_help.description: Each editable value: what it means, what it accepts, its default. Not read by any program.

alerts.description: The alerts, each a reading crossing a line.

daemon.description: Which daemon watches the reading. Accepts: memory, disk, stall.

reading.description: What is measured. Accepts: available_percent (memory: percent of memory available), free_mib (disk: MiB free where the logs and maps are), stalled_s (stall: seconds a running clock has not moved).

below.description: Raise the alert when the reading falls below this. Accepts: a number in the reading's unit. Give below or above, not both.

above.description: Raise the alert when the reading rises above this. Accepts: a number in the reading's unit. Give below or above, not both.

message.description: The message template, by its key in Daemon/messages.json, such as memory.low. Accepts: a key that exists there.

recovered.description: Optional. The template sent once the reading is back over the line.

sustain_s.description: Optional. Seconds the reading must stay over the line before the alert; without it, the launcher's daemon.sustain_s applies (default 5). Accepts: a number from 0 to 300.
